stages.name: gate
stages.claim: where the retention slide left off: selection, the gate z_e ~ Bern(pi), and a Gaussian influence bump next to the retention bump at mu_0

stages.name: tails
stages.claim: the influence bump's shape is a choice: a Gaussian (grey dotted) or a Laplace (teal dotted) with the same mean and variance; the Laplace is taller at the peak and heavier in the tails; the retention bump at mu_0 gets the same teal Laplace
